observation.pressure: A generic relation/type gate can still be fooled if an ingestion step invents edges from temporal order, spatial proximity or other heuristics before semantic validation.
observation.plainLanguage: 先問這條關係是不是資料來源真的給的，再問它是哪一種關係；不能先把兩個東西連起來，再用漂亮的類型名稱替腦補洗白。
observation.positiveBehavior: Consecutive OSM node references encoded by source way structure are admitted as source-schema-derived relation evidence.
observation.negativeBehavior: USGS earthquake feed order and geographic proximity remain HOLD even when they can be formatted as adjacency/connectivity edges.
